headline: Pakistan Foreign Direct Investment Drops 34% in FY26 as Business Leaders Urge Reforms
summary: Net foreign direct investment in Pakistan fell 34% to $1.64 billion in FY26, dropping to about 0.5% of GDP. Prominent industrial leaders called for reducing bureaucratic friction and lowering energy tariffs to stimulate private investment.
why: Foreign direct investment is critical to building foreign exchange reserves and modernizing infrastructure in Pakistan's economy.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: A 34% drop in net FDI highlights persistent challenges in attracting foreign corporate investment.
